issue: Missing authentication guard — unauthenticated users can set role cookie
evidence: No requireAuthApi() call. The endpoint checks locals.user for DB update but still sets activeRole and role cookies for unauthenticated requests (line 54-69).
impact: Unauthenticated user can set activeRole cookie to 'dsa', which is checked in hooks.server.ts for role resolution, potentially influencing routing for onboarding flows.

issue: Client-controlled coin balance — user can set arbitrary coin values
evidence: const { usedCoins, availableCoins } = parsed.data; then directly written to DB: $set: { availableCoins, usedCoins }
impact: Any authenticated user can set their coin balance to any non-negative number, bypassing the coin economy. If coins unlock premium features, this is a privilege escalation.

issue: Command injection via user-controlled pattern parameter passed to exec()
evidence: const cmd = pattern ? `npx vitest run --reporter=json "${pattern}"` : '...'; and then execAsync(cmd, ...). Pattern comes from request body with only double-quote wrapping.
impact: In dev mode, attacker can inject shell commands via pattern field. Dev-only guard prevents production exploitation.

issue: No authentication guard — any unauthenticated user in dev mode can execute shell commands
evidence: No requireAuthApi() or requireRoleApi() call. Only dev check: if (!dev) throw error(404).
impact: In development, any network-accessible client can trigger arbitrary vitest commands and read stdout/stderr output.

issue: Dev-only endpoint creates authenticated sessions without OTP verification
evidence: if (!dev) { throw error(404, 'Not found'); } — only dev guard. Creates real JWT tokens and DB records for test users.
impact: If dev mode is accidentally enabled in production, anyone can create admin sessions.

issue: Unsanitized user data inserted directly into MongoDB collection
evidence: const data = parsed.data; const result = await AppliedApplications.insertOne(data); — no schema validation, no field filtering
impact: Attacker can inject arbitrary fields including MongoDB operators or store malicious payloads (XSS in stored data).

issue: User-controlled email address used directly in sendUserEmail without validation
evidence: await Promise.all([sendUserEmail(data.email, data.fullName), sendAdminEmail(data)]); — data.email is user-supplied, no email format validation
impact: Attacker can specify arbitrary email addresses to send emails from the platform, enabling spam relay.

issue: XSS via unsanitized userName interpolated directly into HTML email template

Hi ${userName},

— userName from user input, no HTML escaping
impact: Stored XSS in email body. If email client renders HTML, attacker can inject malicious scripts or phishing content.

issue: Client-provided filename passed directly to ImageKit upload

issue: activeRole cookie set with httpOnly: false
